name: @qf-jarvis/core-riya-intake
description: QF Jarvis Core-owned Riya intake boundary (RWC-P6, ADR-0101). The strict, versioned, bounded, POWERLESS contract and injected port for the three post-summary questions QuickFurno Core owns: has contact been captured, what did the client decide about consent, and may this confirmed enquiry become a business intake. It carries a current intake state (contact MISSING/READY, consent MISSING/GRANTED/DECLINED/OPTED_OUT, each non-missing state proved by an opaque Core evidence reference), a canonical submission request whose producingSystem is the literal qf-jarvis and which contains no outcome, canSubmit, consent claim or lead reference, a four-outcome result whose ACCEPTED case alone carries the dedicated P6 completion evidence, and an idempotency-keyed lookup so an indeterminate submission is recovered by asking Core rather than by resubmitting. It reuses neither ClientConfirmationV1 (assignment-domain evidence) nor CommunicationAuthorizationV1 (outbound-communication eligibility). It holds NO implementation: no HTTP, fetch, URL, API key, environment read, database, cache, clock, randomness, n8n, provider or model, and no live QuickFurno adapter -- the final integration handshake supplies that. It knows nothing about a conversation: no phase, continuity, observation or reducer. No raw phone, email, name, consent wording, transcript, model output, price, package or payment. Depends on @qf-jarvis/riya-agent for the canonical NeedDiscovery constructor, and zod.
